newsitem.title: USA: Schultz Sav-O sets share repurchase.
newsitem.headline: Schultz Sav-O sets share repurchase.

text.p: Schultz Sav-O Stores Inc said Tuesday its board of directors authorized the repurchase of up to $5 million of its outstanding common stock.
As of December 28, 1996, the company had 4,619,098 common shares outstanding and 445,800 shares of common stock issuable upon exercise of outstanding stock options.

Schultz Sav-O said the shares will be repurchased from time to time in the open market, in privately negotiated transactions and may include, but will not be reduced by, the repurchase of common stock issuable upon the exercise of stock options granted under the company's stock option plans.
The repurchased sharse will be held in treasury pending future issuance for employee benefit, option or stock ownership plans, or for other general corporate purposes.
